lines: (The astronaut's antenna is blinking very fast. Beep beep beep!)
{player}! Am I glad to see you. Look up there, way over the town. Something's floating, glowing blue. My visor says it's paper!
There's another one by the pad, too. Right by my boots.
The only way up to the floaty one is the mothership. Step on the pad and call it down. I'd fly it myself, but it doesn't take Earth licences.
(The astronaut gives a big, slow wave with a blue glove.)
Hello there! Ground control to... um... whoever you are!
Sort of! I'm from Earth, actually. I flew up past the clouds to see the mothership, and look where I landed. Galaxity!
Everything here is so green. Even the sky! Back home the sky is blue.
Ha! I suppose it does. I'll stay right here by the pad and watch the ship go round. Come and say hi any time.
(The astronaut's antenna is blinking. Beep. Beep.)
Did you see that? The portal's open! I wonder if there's a way to Earth through there that doesn't need a rocket.
If you go through to Earth, say hi to the moon for me.
Look at all those stars, {player}. I've been to a few of them.
Well... near a few of them. They're a lot further away than they look.
Good morning! I had space porridge for breakfast. It floats off the spoon, so you have to be quick.

rotate: Do you want to know what the big red button does?
Me too. Nobody ever told me. I'm too scared to press it.
The mothership goes all the way round the town. I've counted it fourteen times today!
Someone told me {player} can fly it. Is that true? Wow.
This helmet is great for keeping my ears warm. And for keeping bugs out of my mouth.
(The astronaut hops up and down on the spot. Boing. Boing.)
Sorry! I keep forgetting there's more gravity here. I'm practising.
